author: GrapeSmoothie
body:
Hello everyone! I'd like to officially announce the creation of The Avicus Network's Events twitch! Here we will have our media team stream the matches each week of the upcoming tournament and more following it. Make sure to follow the channel @ twitch.tv/officialavicus. Voting for the match you want to see will be announced with the fixtures tomorrow.

Regards, -GrapeSmoothie
